name: BullrunData Market Intelligence
description: Real-time macro intelligence for AI agents. Get a US recession probability score from a 15-indicator weighted model, sector rotation signals, institutional flows from CFTC and TIC reports, and cascade scenarios that map how catalysts ripple across markets. 23 read-only tools cover economic indicators (FRED), yield curves, Fed stance, and real estate calculators (BRRRR, investment property). Built for agents that reason about macro context, not just retrieve raw numbers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BullrunData Market Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BullrunData Market Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://market.bullrundata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BullrunData Market Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BullrunData Market Intelligence lists 23 MCP tools, including dashboard_summary, recession_probability, recession_indicators, fed_stance, market_regime, confirmation_status, economic_indicator, list_indicators, interest_rates, inflation_data, employment_data, and housing_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BullrunData Market Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BullrunData Market Intelligence in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does BullrunData Market Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BullrunData Market Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BullrunData Market Intelligence is developed by Bullrun Data. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
